## TRA Timeline

#### IPO and TRA execution

- 2010-09-30: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.12 to S-1/A with blank preamble date
- 2011-06-01: IPO closes; TRA executed at 90% sharing rate with Indigo Pacific Partners LLC and OCM FIE LLC as Stockholder Representatives for the Pre-IPO Stockholders, covering federal NOLs, deferred interest deductions, and AMT credits held as of March 31, 2011
- 2011-12-09: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.12 to post-IPO S-1

#### Settlement of arbitration

- 2012-Q2: First payment of $27.2M for 2011 tax savings plus $0.3M interest
- 2014-04-07: Stockholder Representatives serve demand for arbitration over NOL utilization calculations
- 2014-06-17: Negotiated settlement; Spirit pays $7.0M plus $0.3M interest against $5.6M accrued liability, releasing all obligations

#### Bankruptcy and emergence (no TRA effect)

- 2024-11-18: Chapter 11 filed (Case No. 24-11988 (SHL), S.D.N.Y.)
- 2025-03-12: Plan effective; firm renamed Spirit Aviation Holdings, Inc.; no new TRA created at emergence

## Explanation

Spirit Airlines, Inc. (renamed Spirit Aviation Holdings, Inc. at March 2025 Chapter 11 emergence) executed a Pre-IPO NOL Tax Receivable Agreement on June 1, 2011 at its IPO close, paying 90% of cash tax savings (notably higher than the modal 85% Up-C rate) to Indigo Partners and Oaktree vehicles for federal NOLs, deferred interest deductions, and AMT credits held as of March 31, 2011. After a $27.2M payment in Q2 2012 and subsequent dispute over NOL utilization calculations, the Stockholder Representatives demanded arbitration on April 7, 2014; Spirit settled privately on June 17, 2014 for $7.3M (including interest) against a $5.6M accrued liability, recording the $1.4M excess as other expense and releasing all obligations. No standalone termination instrument was filed on EDGAR; the settlement is documented in the FY2014 10-K Note 18. The 2024 Chapter 11 and March 2025 emergence did not create a new TRA; the contract's economic life ended a decade before the bankruptcy. See `contract_log.md` for the executed text and the settlement documentation.
